metadata.label: Last names with at least 10 bearers among persons registered on 31 December of each year. Year 1999-2020
note: When searching for a name with apostrophe use the character ’

Includes all last names normally at least 10 bearers (during one of the presented years) among persons registered on 31 December for each year, excluding persons with protected identities. Each spelling variant of a name is presented as a unique name.  . . = less than 10 bearers.
